title: Delay, Plateau, or Collapse: Evaluating the Impact of Systematic Verification Error on RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2605.02909v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is designed for tasks with verifiable ground-truth answers, real-world verifiers (e.g., static code checkers) can introduce errors into the reward signal. Prior analyses have largely treated such errors as random and independent across samples, concluding that errors merely slow training with limited effect on final performance. However, practical verifiers tend to exhibit systematic errors. This introduces a risk of models learning unwanted consistent behavior from a structurally incorrect reward signal. In this work, we study the impact of such systematic verification errors on RLVR. translated_title: 延迟、停滞或崩溃：评估系统性验证错误对RLVR的影响
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLMs）推理能力的强大方法。尽管RLVR专为具有可验证标准答案的任务而设计，但现实世界中的验证器（例如静态代码检查器）可能会在奖励信号中引入错误。以往的分析大多将这些错误视为跨样本的随机且独立的，并得出结论：错误只会减慢训练速度，对最终性能影响有限。然而，实际验证器往往表现出系统性错误。这引入了模型从结构错误的奖励信号中学习到不期望的一致行为的风险。在本工作中，我们研究了这种系统性验证错误对RLVR的影响。通过在算术任务上的受控实验，我们表明系统性假阴性会导致与随机噪声类似的效果。另一方面，系统性假阳性则……
tldr: 本文通过受控实验揭示，系统性验证错误（尤其是假阳性）对RLVR训练的影响远超随机噪声，可能导致模型性能停滞或崩溃，而非仅减缓训练速度。
en_tdlr: This work reveals through controlled experiments that systematic verification errors, especially false positives, impact RLVR training far beyond random noise, potentially causing performance plateau or collapse rather than merely slowing training.
